tdeck.name: LilyGo T-Deck
download_mode: Connect the T-Deck to this computer with a USB cable that carries data.
Press the trackball in and keep holding it.
While holding it, press and release the RST button.
Let go of the trackball. The screen stays dark: the device is in download mode.
Click the Flash button again and pick the port.
When flashing ends, press RST once if the device does not restart by itself.

heltec_v4.name: Heltec V4 + Expansion Kit V2
download_mode: Connect the Heltec to this computer with a USB cable that carries data.
Press the USER button and keep holding it (it is the same input as PRG on the mainboard).
While holding it, press and release the RST button.
Let go of USER. The screen stays dark: the device is in download mode.
Click the Flash button again and pick the port.
When flashing ends, press RST once if the device does not restart by itself.

wio_l2.name: Seeed Wio Tracker L2
download_mode: Connect the Wio Tracker L2 to this computer with a USB cable that carries data.
Press the USER button and keep holding it.
While holding it, reset the device.
Let go of USER. The screen stays dark: the device is in download mode.
Click the Flash button again and pick the port.
When flashing ends, reset the device once if it does not restart by itself.
